summary: Tested Awkwardish backend (RSS episodes + Mailchimp newsletter) and frontend integration end-to-end. All 9 backend pytest cases pass and the live UI renders 6 episodes pulled from the Anchor RSS feed with correct metadata; newsletter form handles invalid input client-side and shows the real success message after a real Mailchimp PUT.

minor.issue: On unexpected upstream errors the route returns generic 500 with the raw exception in detail; consider sanitising exception messages before returning them in production.

logger is referenced inside list_episodes but defined AFTER include_router/middleware (lines 328-333). Works because handler runs later, but moving logging.basicConfig + logger to the top of the module is cleaner and avoids a NameError if an exception fires during startup parsing.

action_items: Optional: move logging.basicConfig/logger definition to the top of /app/backend/server.py for hygiene.
Optional: avoid leaking raw exception text in HTTPException detail for /api/newsletter/subscribe and /api/episodes 502 paths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is fine size-wise (~340 lines). All env-driven config, no hard-coded URLs, async/await used for DB and Mailchimp/RSS via asyncio.to_thread.
MongoDB queries already exclude _id via projection in /api/status — good.
RSS in-memory cache is fine for a single-pod deploy; will not be shared across replicas if scaled. Acceptable for current MVP.
Pydantic EmailStr correctly produces 422 on invalid/missing email.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL through a single axios client — clean.
All key UI elements have data-testid (episodes-section, newsletter-form, episode-card-N, newsletter-email-input, newsletter-submit, newsletter-success, newsletter-error).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Newsletter test creates Mailchimp subscriber qa+awktest<random>@gmail.com and qa+ui<random>@gmail.com (idempotent PUT, safe to re-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_awkwardish.py covers root, status CRUD, episodes (default/limit/cache), newsletter (success/idempotent/422 invalid/422 missing). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Live RSS show_title is 'Awkwardish'. Mailchimp will reject example.com — use gmail.com domain in tests.
